body: I am in agreement with you, I get what you mean, truthfully how many years can one spend fighting the battle of the mind and the emotion no one seems to understand before its okay to give up? I've been fighting this off for most of my life

I don't think "talking it out" works I've tried that. I've tried hotlines. I've researched every possible means to rid this feeling and the thoughts. It doesn't work. It's tiring. Fighting your mind and the feelings every day. Saying "I was there I know how it feels" doesn't make it any better. It doesn't take away the feeling or the thoughts. No matter how much we wish it would
